FIXED A REAL BUG found during the mandatory manual read-back: flow_to_lines_html() was splitting each text segment on '\n' BEFORE protecting $$...$$ math spans, so any multi-line display-math block (aligned environments, which carry literal embedded newlines in their own source text) got shredded into fragments with no complete $$ pair in any single fragment - the math regex never matched and raw LaTeX (backslash commands and all) leaked straight into the rendered page as escaped text (252 leftover command names, 304 stray backslashes on the first render). Fixed by protecting math across the whole segment before splitting on newlines, matching the same protect/restore pattern already used elsewhere in the script.
